summary: Frontend UI verification for Phase 9I enhancements. 3 of 4 features working; 1 critical mismatch: Rooming Room Type is still an <Input> text field, not a Select dropdown with SINGLE/DOUBLE/TRIPLE/QUAD as required.

ui_bugs.issue: Room Type column is rendered with <Input className='h-8 w-28' /> instead of a Select dropdown. The required options SINGLE/DOUBLE/TRIPLE/QUAD are NOT presented as dropdown; user types free-text. Select is imported (line 9) but not used for room_type. On live test element info: {tag: 'INPUT', type: null, placeholder: null}. Screenshot confirms value 'QUAD' rendered inside a text box.

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)' on multiple chart containers; container mount race — should set explicit min height/width.

rca of the issue: Operations.jsx RoomingTab was updated but the room_type cell was not migrated to Select. Fix: replace the <Input> with <Select value={val(p,'room_type')} onValueChange={(v) => setVal(p.traveler_id,'room_type',v)}><SelectTrigger data-testid={`rooming-room_type-${p.traveler_id}`}><SelectValue placeholder='Pilih' /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent>{['SINGLE','DOUBLE','TRIPLE','QUAD'].map(x => <SelectItem key={x} value={x}>{x}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent></Select>.
